title: Whoop Axe Throwing
specs: Largest axe venue in Southern California
Dancing nights with unlimited small axe throwing
Rage room for up to 4 people at a time
Minimum age 14 to throw axes; any age can hang out
No throwing axes while intoxicated or under influence
No throwing axes with non-dominant hand unless ambidextrous or medical excuse
Groups of 2-20 can book online with automatic discounts
Groups of 15+ must coordinate catering via email
Venue rental ideal for parties of 70+

blurb: Guests throw axes at targets with coaching on different axe sizes. The venue offers dancing nights with unlimited small axe throwing from 8PM to midnight. They host parties, corporate events, and have a snack bar and yard games for kids.
